fullContentHtml:
Short Details : has declared the Class 10th (High School) and Class 12th (Higher Secondary) Second Exam Result 2026. The board examinations were conducted from 11 February 2026 to 7 March 2026 at various examination centers across the state. After completing the evaluation process, the MP Board Class 10th & 12th Result 2026 has now been released on the official website. Students who appeared in the board examinations can check their Second Exam results which has given below.

Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education (MPBSE)

MP Board 10th / 12th Second Exam Result 2026

Exam Name – MP Board 10th / 12th Annual Board Exam 2026

Important Dates

  • 10th High School Annual Exam Between : 11 February 2026 to 2 March 2026
  • 12th Intermediate Annual Exam Between : 7 February 2026 to 5 March 2026
  • Result Available : 15 April 2026
  • Second Exam 10th/12th Result : Available

Exam Details

  • Exam Name – MP Board Class 10th / 12th Annual Board Exam 2026
  • Exam Conducted By : Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education (MPBSE) Conducted the Examination of Inter 10th / 12th Examination 2026

MP Board 10th / 12th Second Exam Result 2026

  • The MP Board 10th / 12th Result 2026 will published online soon. Candidates will be required to check the MP Board 10th / 12th Result 2026 result by entering the correct details in the credential box. After the declaration of the result, it will be the responsibility of the student to cheek the MP Board 10th / 12th Result 2026 result. The MP Board 10th / 12th Result 2026 will available soon.

MP Board 10th / 12th Second Exam Result 2026

  • The MP Board 10th / 12th Result 2026 can be checked through online mode. But before checking the MP Board 10th / 12th Result 2026, candidates must keep their Roll number or Enrollment Number or Index Number ready in hand with them as the page displaying the result will require such credential of the student to display the MP Board 10th / 12th Result 2026.
  • Students should also check after getting the registration card that their name, photo, date of birth, cast, religion, nationality, gender, subject etc. details are filled correctly.
  • If you see any mistake, get it corrected immediately. SarkariExam.com wishes all the very best for their Board Exam.

Instructions For Checking MP Board 10th / 12th Second Exam Result 2026

  • In order o check the result, candidates must visit the Important Links section below.
  • Here they have to click in the Download Class 10th/ 12th Second Exam Result link.
  • After that a new page will be opened.
  • In this new page, candidates have to enter their Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  • Then they have to click on the Get Marks button
  • After submitting the correct details, candidates an check the Second Exam result.
  • Alternatively, the candidate can check the result also from the official website of MP Board 10th / 12th Second Exam Results.

Q. When was the MP Board Result 2026 released?
Answer. The MP Board Class 10th and 12th Result 2026 was released on 15 April 2026 at 11:00 AM.

Q. How can students check the MP Board Result 2026?
Answer. Students can check their result online using their Roll Number and Application Number.

Q. When were the MP Board exams conducted?
Answer. The exams were held from 11 February 2026 to 7 March 2026.

Q. What details are required to check the result?
Answer. Students need their Roll Number and Application Number.

Q. How to get the original marksheet?
Answer. Students can download the provisional marksheet online and collect the original marksheet from their school later.
